issues.title: Terrain protrudes through the carriageway (road sunk up to 0.44 m)
issues.detail: Probe: 28/1254 samples on non-bridge edges sit >5 cm below the heightfield, worst -0.44 m at (+-40,-79) and -0.40 m on the north bridge approach (z~-320). A grass rectangle sits on the avenue next to the crossroads in closeup_12/17.5/6.5 and intersection_12. Flatten brushes (strength 3, skip-if-within-4 cm) do not converge on slopes and ROAD_LIFT is 0.03 m. Fix: after flattenTerrain() verify every strip row has T.getHeight <= row.y - DROP and re-brush or write heights directly under the strip; raise ROAD_LIFT to ~0.08 m; clamp the profile above terrain inside the strip.

issues.title: Terrain grass instances render through asphalt and sidewalks in every street-level frame
issues.detail: world.roads.coverage/isRoad is published but terrain does not consume it yet. Until it does, roads.showcase.setup must call ctx.modules.terrain.setGrassTufts(false) (API exists), and long-term terrain must skip tufts where isRoad(x,z)!==0 on roads:changed.

issues.title: Bridge deck ends float in the air; embankments end as sheer black cliffs
issues.detail: Far end of the street bridge hovers above the beach with an air gap and no abutment (bridge_12); the highway at the coast ends in a dark void under the deck start with a black-walled cut (coastwest_12). Fix: emit abutment blocks with wing walls from deck end to ground, continue the gravel skirt under the deck end, start the deck where the skirt reaches ~1.5 m.

issues.title: Noon frames washed out and flat; sidewalks near white, no AO under kerbs
issues.detail: Every 12:00 frame has p1 luminance >= 97 and std <= 24 (street_12: p1 104, sat 0.20). Concrete material multiplies albedo by 1.75; asphalt reads mid-grey; no contact shadow at kerbs. Fix: concrete colour <= 1.0 with darker kerb-face vertex colour, asphalt base ~0.30, baked AO in vertex colour along kerb faces and under parapets; environment owes a real exposure curve (shared).

issues.title: White speckle/sparkle across asphalt at mid distance and grazing angles
issues.detail: Specular aliasing on highway_12 and merge_12 from the normal map plus roughness reductions (wearLight, noise term) without mip-aware roughness. Fix: clamp roughness >= 0.6, fade normalScale and the polished-lane term with distance, set anisotropy on PBR maps, add geometric roughness from fwidth(normal).

issues.title: Flatten brushes cut a sheer rectangular wall through the knoll beside the loop's north arm
issues.detail: Dark rectangular cut visible in loop_12 near (-215,-190) and as a dark spot in the aerials. Fix: grade the cut (max depth per metre of lateral distance, ~1:1.5) or emit a retaining-wall mesh where the cut exceeds ~1.5 m, per ARCHITECTURE 12 cut/fill.

issues.title: One-way loop is not a roundabout
issues.detail: Square/octagonal ring with four T-junctions carrying zebra crossings, stop lines and turn arrows on the ring itself. Fix: detect one-way cycles, sample finer, suppress crosswalks/stop lines/arrows on ring arms, add yield lines on entries and a central island kerb.

issues.title: Corner sidewalk fillet overlaps the crosswalk; sidewalk slabs read as floating plates
issues.detail: The corner strip covers part of the zebra bars, and where terrain falls away the sidewalk shows as a flat grey plate with a thin skirt. Fix: start crosswalks inside the fillet tangent point; extend the skirt to the terrain foot along corner paths too.

issues.title: Pier caps protrude beyond the deck edge; bridge reflections break into dark speckle on the water
issues.detail: Near-end pier cap pokes out beside the deck in bridge_12; dark speckles around the bridge in every aerial. Fix: cap width <= deck outer width; lighten deck underside/pier colours.

issues.title: Asphalt texture tiling visible as a repeating crack grid
issues.detail: 4.2 m repeat shows in intersection polygons and top-down views (armtop_12, street_17p5). Fix: blend two UV scales with noise-driven rotation per tile.

issues.title: Turn arrows are thin hooked shapes
issues.detail: CS2 arrows are bold with proper heads. Fix: 0.3 m shaft, 1.2 m head, build bent arrows from a polyline with round joins.

issues.title: Highway lacks shoulder/edge detail and gore markings at the merge; barrier reads as a line
issues.detail: Add chevron gore area at the ramp nose, a hard-shoulder edge line inset, and a lighter barrier top colour.

issues.title: rebuild() is not idempotent; removeEdge leaves orphan nodes
issues.detail: Same network rebuilt after its own terrain flattening yields 45922 -> 45524 tris. Determinism (ARCHITECTURE 11) wants identical results for identical actions.

issues.title: Scene draw calls exceed 80 at skyline although roads' own share is <= 49
issues.detail: 85-86 total at 1080p skyline (terrain+environment+roads). Roads is 25 meshes (8 tiles x 4 materials) plus concrete shadow casters per cascade; folding paint decals into the asphalt material would save 8 draw calls.

strengths: world.roads API complete and correct: arc-length sampling, quadratic bezier edges, lane 0 on the right, frontage on both sides, nearestEdge, cascade removal, version + roads:changed discipline; zero console errors in 29 captures and two probes
Intersection analysis with fillet/mitre/flat corners, joints, dead-end caps and a real kerb + sidewalk + gravel-skirt profile; per-type widths for alley/street/avenue/highway/ramp
Shader lane-marking system (dashed/solid/double, yellow highway inner lines, solid near stop lines, wheel-track wear, paint wear) plus zebra, stop-line and arrow decals
Dual carriageway with median Jersey barrier and a ramp merge with acceleration-lane taper; bridges with deck, parapets and piers with caps standing in the water
Terrain-conforming smoothed profiles, coverage mask and lampPositions/intersections for other modules, per-tile merged meshes, CC0 assets, deterministic (no Math.random)
summary: Solid road-network engineering (API, intersections, markings, bridges, ramps) undermined by hard-fail visuals in the standard shots: terrain poking through the carriageway (sunk up to 0.44 m), grass instances through the asphalt everywhere, floating bridge ends and cliff-cut embankments, washed-out flat noon frames and sparkling asphalt at mid distance. 0 console errors, module ready everywhere, API contract verified; roads' own draw calls <= 49 (scene total peaks at 86). 6.0, fail.
